# TOMOGO! Travel

> > TOMOGO! offers personalized guided tours and custom travel experiences exploring Tokyo, Osaka, Kyoto, and Japan's hidden neighborhoods, local culture, and authentic experiences.

TOMOGO! specializes in curated Japan travel with expert local guides leading intimate tours through neighborhoods like Yanesen, Kichijoji, and Akihabara, plus custom multi-day packages. The company focuses on authentic cultural immersion, from traditional tea ceremonies and vegan cuisine to anime culture and Tokyo nightlife.

## Key Topics

- Tokyo neighborhoods
- Custom Japan itineraries
- Local guides
- Japanese culture & traditions
- Cafe culture & kissaten
- Osaka & Kyoto experiences
- Vegan & plant-based dining
- Anime & otaku culture
- Traditional crafts & souvenirs
- Tea ceremony & matcha
- Tokyo nightlife & bar hopping
- Hidden local spots
- Personalized tours
- Family-friendly travel
- Regional specialties
